tasks.label: Vibe: 포토부스 미리보기
args: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3012 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host 'Port 3012 already serves the preview. Reusing it.' } else { & 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe' 'node_modules/next/dist/bin/next' dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3012 }
